description: The Blue-Green Deployment Strategy for AWS ECS is designed to enhance application availability and reliability during updates. This project will involve setting up two identical environments, referred to as 'Blue' and 'Green'. The current version of the application will run in the Blue environment, while the Green environment will host the new version. The deployment process will include configuring AWS ECS services, load balancers, and routing policies to facilitate seamless switching between environments. This strategy minimizes downtime and allows for quick rollbacks in case of issues, ensuring a smooth user experience. The project will also include thorough testing and validation of the new version in the Green environment before switching traffic, along with documentation to guide future deployments. By implementing this strategy, businesses can significantly reduce risks associated with application updates and maintain operational continuity.
